discovery.client: scripts/discover.py finds each client module this addon imports by how the client uses it (for example `X.threadShellAtom(`) and follows the import chain to the chunk export that provides it. Chunk names and export aliases are rendered into host.mjs from src/host.template at install time and recorded in the install receipt, never pinned.
discovery.onFailure: The install still proceeds because the overlay only adds files; the addon shows a dismissible note at runtime saying what could not be found.
